transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Nice to meet you, Dr. Smith. Well, I'm here because... mostly I just don't feel like myself anymore. I've completely stopped doing the things I used to do. I stopped hiking, coaching, playing my guitar... I don't even call people back anymore. 

It's gotten to the point where some days I just sit in my small rental for hours. I know there are things I need to get done, but I just... I can't make myself start.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It's been about a year and two months. I guess... things really just started unraveling since I moved into this smaller rental, right after my divorce.
During this past year, have there been any periods of a few weeks or more where you felt significantly worse than you do right now, or has your mood been consistently low like this the entire time?

I don't think so, no. It hasn't really... dipped into anything worse for a few weeks or anything like that. It's just been pretty consistently like this. Just flat and low, pretty much the whole time.
Over this past year, have you noticed any consistent changes in your appetite or your eating habits?
No, not really. I haven't noticed any changes with my appetite. I mean... I still eat about the same amount I always have. My eating habits are pretty much normal.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns over this past year, such as having trouble falling asleep or sleeping more than usual?
No, my sleep has been... pretty normal, actually. I don't really have trouble falling asleep, and I'm not sleeping in or anything like that. Just sticking to my usual schedule.
Do you often feel like you aren't good enough, or do you frequently criticize yourself?

No, I don't really have that. I mean... I don't sit around criticizing myself or thinking I'm not good enough. It's not really like that. I just sort of... get through the day, I guess. But no, I don't really beat myself up over things or feel like that.
Do you feel like you have less energy throughout the day than you used to?

No, my energy is fine. I mean... I still have the same amount of energy I usually do. I haven't noticed feeling more tired or drained during the day or anything like that. I just get through my shifts and do what I need to do.
Do you find it difficult to concentrate on tasks or make decisions throughout your day?

No, I don't really have trouble with that. I mean, my concentration is about the same as always. I can still focus on my work and... make decisions when I need to. I haven't noticed it getting harder to think straight or anything.
Do you often feel a sense of hopelessness about the future?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I don't really think about the future all that much, to be honest. I just take things one day at a time, you know? Go to work, come home... I wouldn't say I feel hopeless about it. It's just... there.
